text_block_list.text:
Summer arrived.
Gathered here for training camp.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Man, brutal……
Hot and feet keep slipping……!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Hard keeping form, huh～……
……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew……!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa～……! As expected of Verxina-san……
Just like at academy, form is immaculate……!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Even on sand, looks like picture……
Right, let's keep motivated!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……Phew. Apologies, Trainer-san.
Having you fetch this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Beach run finished. ……Felt training load was lighter than usual though――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……Beach dashes effective.
Poor footing means long sessions risk injury…… correct?
――Of course. Put serious thought into regime this time.

Expected duty as trainer, but……
Honestly wanted to make up for last time……

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Next menu item is swimming, right……?
How long should I rest?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then……
About time for light prep, yes?

Right. Today execute perfectly.
Monitored split times, passed towels and hydration promptly.
To be reliable trainer for Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer-san.
Thank you again for guidance.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……You look exhausted.
Are you alright?
choice_data_list: Maybe I was a little too enthusiastic
Maybe I was a little too enthusiastic

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
True for both of us.
Tough environment gets fire burning in me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right, right.
Barbecue planned tonight.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Growing hungry now……
Maybe ask for extra portions today.
Returned from camp with high spirits――

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Wha…… no fire starter? No matches or lighters?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Meat…… won't get cooked? Can't cook……? Meat……?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: No waaaay~! Stuck eating raw veggies then—!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Calm down, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ……Will be fine. I'll handle it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……No firestarter or lighter, huh.
Now, what to do……?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: First, need to figure out how to start fire, yes?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh…… Trainer-san,
something in mind?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. In that case,
I'll start gathering firewood.

……Said that, but
not entirely certain on proper method.

Standard method exists for primitive fires.
First, need wooden stick to start.

――15 minutes later……
Exhausted already, zero spark.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Everyone pitched in,
plenty of firewood ready.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fire…… still in progress, looks like.
Need hand?
choice_data_list: Thanks! But just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, no, too early for you two to use matches.
Leave it to big sister.

text_block_list.name: Their Mother
text_block_list.text:
My my～. Think you can handle it?
Could just let Mama do it, you know～?

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-I've got this!
Done it before, so――

text_block_list.name: Their Mother
text_block_list.text:
……Fufu. Very well, leave it to you.
You are "big sister" after all, yes?

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text: H-here goes…… hup!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……Fufu.
Do your best, Trainer-san.
Then―― as sun began sinking――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: …………It caught!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Phew～ worried there for bit.
Meat tastes amazing～.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Really does…… thanks to Verxina-senpai,
we aren't stuck eating raw veggies～.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, really, I didn't do anything special.
Trainer-san's the one who lit the fire, after all.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... you're so right! Trainer-san!
You're officially the Savior of the Meats from now on!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Truly, thank you for all your hard work today,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Was it Trainer-san?
............

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that.
You just asked something so completely obvious.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You always have been. Ever since you became my trainer,
Trainer-san has been my absolute pride.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Incredibly earnest. Always working so hard――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Then I suppose that makes the two of us cut from the same cloth.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since I met you, Trainer-san――I think I've
finally come to understand how my sisters look up to me.
choice_data_list: Think you can start relying on me?
Think you can start relying on me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. In that case, maybe I'll take you up on that offer――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――Do you think you could grill up a little more delicious meat for us?
